The synthetic app built with 1, 10, 20, …, 100 components (each line, left to right): its compressed wasm size
against the time to build it (compile, optimize, compress; 4 cores; median of 3). Bottom-left is best.
optimized for size (opt-level "z", LTO, wasm-opt -Oz, brotli -q 11)
